Reject new production work, requeues, experiments, telemetry, dependencies, deployments, spending, monetization changes, and unsupported financial claims. Continue only existing repair-or-close, measurement/attribution reconciliation, and bounded legal/security evidence work. Preserve aggregate commission as unattributed, private launch gates, parked dispositions, and unknown ROI, margin, payback, cost-to-learn, and causal lift.
